d:
Kanun ki bat – rashtriy lok adalat 12 disanbar 2026 ko: sulah-samjhaute se mamlon ka tvarit niptara | janen prakriya, labh aur kanuni adhikar | DD JHARKHAND
Kya aapka koee mamla lanbe samay se adalat men lanbit hai ya aap baink rin, bijli bil, chek bauns aur parivarik vivadon se pareshan hain? aise mamlon ke tvarit aur kam kharch men samadhan ke lie 12 disanbar 2026 ko rashtriy lok adalat ka aayojan kiya jaega.
